recordings.title: Support triage and a graph pipeline
recordings.description: A triage agent runs three tools in parallel, retries one, delegates a refund and returns structured output. Then a graph run loops through write and review.

recordings.title: A run that fails
recordings.description: An unregistered agent, observed from its spans. One fetch times out and fails the run; the recording ends with a request still streaming.

recordings.title: Content capture off
recordings.description: The same structure with include_content=False: no prompts, arguments or results are stored.

recordings.title: Approvals and deferred calls
recordings.description: A run ends waiting for two approvals and an external result; the next run in the conversation approves one call, denies the other and supplies the result.
